summary.headline: Theodosius on the Day of Death
summary.text: Theodosius on determining the day of death from solstitial horoscopy, the Moon’s position, the midheaven, term-rulers, exaltation, benefic and malefic aspects, with an example using Leo, Taurus, Mercury, Virgo, and Venus. The preceding passage discusses annual prediction through transits of the Sun, Moon, benefics, malefics, and fixed stars.
